title: Additional update type
text: The purpose of the Additional update type information element is to provide additional information about the type of request for an attach or a tracking area updating procedure
The Additional update type information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.3.0B.1 and table 9.9.3.0B.1
The Additional update type is a type 1 information element
